records.matchup: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings
records.summary: Thorman argues Green Bay's historically slow/run-heavy game environment could speed up because Josh Jacobs is unavailable, the defense is suspect, and the WR rotation is more condensed, pushing toward more passing and fewer substitution-driven clock drains. He also expects Minnesota to rebound from last year's unusually slow offense with Kyler Murray replacing J.J. McCarthy, while Brian Flores' boom-or-bust blitz defense adds game-environment volatility. He characterizes the indoor matchup as having a strong chance to become more back-and-forth than the teams' 2025 pace/points profile suggests.
